input.query:
MATCH (impl:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(iface:Type)
WHERE iface.fqn IN [
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.entitiy.dashboard.TbDashboardService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.dashboard.DashboardService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.tenant.TenantService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.user.UserService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.security.permission.AccessControlService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.dao.customer.CustomerService',
  'org.thingsboard.server.service.resource.TbResourceService'
]
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(impl)
RETURN iface.fqn AS interface, impl.fqn AS implementation,
  split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(impl.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS file
ORDER BY interface
